problems: Elenchus is badly OCR-garbled (digits, titles), cross-checked against the Ordo: Ordo agrees on Notitia 9, Beveregius 19, Apostolorum 35, Cpol II (reads 509), Ephesus 347, 1003, 1095, 1195, 1273; Ordo garbles Ancyra (1131), Gangra (1255), Laodicea and Sardica numbers; every column confirmed from page numbers in the body.

Title of the sixth item reads 'synodi Quinisexte' in the Elenchus but the body head is 'De quinta synodo' (col 497), with 'De sexta synodo' at ~col 499 and the Trullan canons at 501; the Elenchus's two items (497, 501) map to these.

Not entered (neither in Elenchus nor Ordo): a synod's canons headed 'THS AGIAS SYNODOU (65), THS EN TO ... NAO' ('sanctae synodi quae in celebri templo ...') at line 92613, col 1083, inside the Cpol I and II block; and Balsamon's commentary on the canonical epistles of the Fathers (the Elenchus title says 'et in Epistolas canonicas SS. Patrum'), whose heads are not separately listed in the Elenchus or Ordo (volume runs to col 1497 after Sardica 1422).
Elenchus counts Nicaea I as '917'; its body head is at col 217 (2 misread as 9, and Ordo repeats '911'); considered garbled, not a disagreement.
